en-US.description: What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..
en-US.name: GodotHub
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's new in v1.5.8
Fixes
- Projects no longer show as still running when you reopen GodotHub after the editor was already closed, and opening them no longer warns that they are already open (#289)
- With Close on Project Open turned on, time spent in the editor is now tracked. GodotHub hides its window instead of quitting, keeps timing the session in the background, and quits on its own once the editor closes. Before, the whole session was lost (#289)
- Dropdown menus with long lists, like the project picker in Save to Vault, no longer close when you scroll them, so every item can be picked (#282)
- Each setup step now opens scrolled to the top instead of keeping the previous step's scroll position (#284)
- Switching between light and dark system theme no longer undoes settings you changed since the last switch
- A settings change made while an earlier one was still saving is no longer lost
- Pressing Enter in a dialog while projects are selected no longer launches them, and Delete or Backspace on a button no longer asks to remove them
- Escape now closes only the open menu or date picker instead of the whole task editor, task list, Project Doctor or Git sidebar, so typed text isn't lost
- Cancel on the Dashboard greeting editor now discards the name instead of saving it
- Undo after removing a project now shows it in the list again right away
- Selecting text in a dialog and letting go of the mouse outside it no longer closes the dialog
- Shift-click in the Kanban view now selects the cards between your clicks as they appear in the columns, instead of picking cards from other columns
- The command palette shortcut recorder stops listening when you click elsewhere, so it no longer grabs the next key you type
- Switching the release source quickly on the Versions page no longer shows the other source's list
- Asset Library search no longer shows results for an older query after you keep typing
- Vault tag filters clear once their last item is gone, so the list no longer stays empty with no way to reset it
- Sort: Oldest for available versions now orders the versions inside each group oldest first too
- Project cards show the new git status right after a commit or pull from the Git sidebar
- A failed Storage refresh now shows an error instead of silently keeping the old numbers
- Enter works on the buttons in Manage Tags again
- The focus search shortcut now works on the Templates page
Improvements
- Linux: page entrance animations skip the blur effect and the Dashboard activity chart animates more cheaply, which should reduce lag on the Dashboard. Windows and macOS look the same as before (#271)
- Other git worktrees of a project no longer show up as separate projects. Each repository shows once and you switch worktrees from its Git sidebar. Worktrees that were already listed separately are merged into one entry and keep their tracked time
- The search bars on the Vault and Templates pages now fill the whole row
- Date picker weekday names are readable in Arabic and Vietnamese
- More text is translated: the project size scan, the GitHub token reset time, the clone task status and the starter categories you add during setup

Platform│Architecture           │Package                │Download
────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────

────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows │x64                    │MSI installer          │GodotHub-1.5.8-windows-x64.msi
────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows │x64                    │Portable, no install   │GodotHub-1.5.8-windows-x64-portable.exe
────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS   │Apple Silicon and Intel│Disk image             │GodotHub-1.5.8-darwin-universal.dmg
────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux   │x64                    │AppImage               │GodotHub-1.5.8-linux-amd64.AppImage
────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux   │x64                    │Debian, Ubuntu (.deb)  │GodotHub-1.5.8-linux-amd64.deb
────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux   │x64                    │Fedora, openSUSE (.rpm)│GodotHub-1.5.8-linux-x86_64.rpm
────────┴───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────
Package managers
- winget: winget install Ryko.GodotHub
- Scoop: scoop bucket add extras then scoop install godothub
- AM (Linux): am -i godothub
Already using GodotHub? It offers this update in the app.
AppImage not starting on Linux?
The AppImage does not run on every Linux setup. If it fails to start, install it with AM instead. AM downloads the same AppImage from this page, adds GodotHub to your app menu, and updates it with am -u godothub.
1. Install AM:
wget -q https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-hc/AM/main/AM-INSTALLER && chmod a+x ./AM-INSTALLER && ./AM-INSTALLER && rm ./AM-INSTALLER
2. Install GodotHub:
am -i godothub
If you chose AppMan in the AM installer, use appman -i godothub instead.
Full changelog: v1.5.7...v1.5.8
